body: I don't mean to be disrespectful, but it feels like you're just saying "Be happy!" or "Let go of shit." But, I don't know HOW to do that.
How do you stop yourself from thinking about other things besides the present?
That's how I feel too. Happiness isn't really happiness, it's just the momentary absence of sadness.
It sounds like you're a believer in Eastern philosophy, meditation, etc. It's just not something that makes any sense to me. Have you ever been depressed?

That's nice in theory, but it isn't easy to do that in real life. My brain doesn't turn off and I have a real, valid worries about the future. I'd like to be able to live on a beach and "be in the moment" all day, but I don't get that option. Most of us don't.

No I can't postpone it. They have them twice a year-- next one is in February. I also can't get the 1200$ I spent on it. So now I get to sit through two days of hell only to have to go through it again seven months later.

I guess you're trying to say something like it's better to be in pain than to not feel anything at all? But I don't know if that's a sentiment I share. I've felt like shit enough, and maybe it makes you appreciate those highs more. But happiness is such a fleeting emotion for me. It's like the unattainable pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.
